title: An agent can draw a picture with shapes, paths, text, measurements and components
goal: Claude can build a picture in Photonz out of real, editable layers: shapes, paths, text, the app's own measurements and Library components, then export it as PNG or SVG. The user's icon and screenshot scenarios run end to end. This is the third slice of the user's MCP ask.
notes: Split out of claude-can-make-and-edit-pictures-and-videos-in (2026-10-19 manager pass); scenarios 2 and 3 are quoted from the user's words there. Builds on the command table from every-command-in-the-app-s-menus-can-be-run-by-n. Measurements: the app's own Measure tool model (PhotonzCore Measurement types), never drawn lines. SVG: SVGExporter (PhotonzRender/SVGExporter.swift). Library components: the ui-building epic's component model; if components cannot be placed from outside the UI that is a gap to file.
acceptance: Typed tools where a menu command cannot carry the arguments: add a shape with its frame and style, a path from points, text with font, size and colour, set a layer's frame and style, place a size or gap measurement between two boxes, place a Library component, export PNG and SVG
Each tool lands as one undo step and leaves a normal layer a person can edit by hand afterwards

Scenario 2 from a fresh Claude Code session with only the server: 'Create a product icon svg of a box inside of a cloud.' The icon is built from shapes and paths in a Photonz document (never a pasted SVG string) and exported as SVG; the SVG and a render go in the audit

Scenario 3: with a UI screenshot open, 'annotate the ux with measurements around the major ui elements'. Before and after pictures go in the audit, with how many measurements were placed and how many land on a real edge, measured against the pixels
A capability either scenario needs that the app lacks is filed as its own p1 task (source user), not faked
Unit tests for the new tool schemas; Scripts/test.sh passes
Audit written under queue/audits/. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Slice 1 landed (an-agent-can-reach-the-running-app-read-the-open): the channel, the bridge and 9 tools. Add tools in PhotonzCore AgentTools (schema + AgentRequest case, tested) and carry them out in Sources/Photonz/Agent/AgentWork.swift; edits must go through EditorState.perform so one undo takes one agent step. Try path: Scripts/install-mcp.sh --probe, or claude -p --mcp-config with PHOTONZ_APP=probe Scripts/photonz-mcp.sh. Design and tool plan: docs/design/agent-mcp.md.
owns no walks; the ones it names are examples

Review before building: the scenarios need an agent to find UI elements and snap to them, which the Measure tool already does by point (Size and Gap clicks), so add_measurement takes a point as well as boxes, and find_elements lists what a Size click would read. A Photoshop user expects shapes, paths and text to stay editable: every tool lands the tool's own layer, a box's line as a Border. Nothing either scenario needed was missing, so no prerequisite was filed.

Review after: three fresh-session runs of scenario 3. Run 1 floated distances beside elements (5 of 13 on edges) and read fields at their inner border; fixed find_elements (Size mode's reader, band rows) and the tool wording. Final run 11 of 13 on edges, all numbers equal to Size clicks. Then matched the canvas's neighbour gathering for Size readouts (AgentMeasurePlan.sizeNeighbors).

left rough: readouts crowd near the top right switch and the fields when an agent measures every control (the Measure tool's own readout planner; a click places them the same way now); not filed, no person report yet. Icon house look and the skill belong to claude-can-make-and-edit-pictures-and-videos-in. CanvasMeasure.neighbors could call AgentMeasurePlan.sizeNeighbors instead of its own copy; left alone to keep the canvas untouched.

Ten drawing tools (new_picture, add_shape, add_path, add_text, set_layer, find_elements, add_measurement, list_components, place_component, export PNG/SVG) in PhotonzCore/AgentDrawing.swift + Agent/AgentDrawingWork.swift, each the matching tool's own layer as one undo step. Verified: 13,860 tests green (new AgentDrawingTests, AgentElementScanFixtureTests on a real screenshot); scenario 2 from a fresh session gave a 10-layer icon and a 953-byte vector SVG; scenario 3 placed 13 measurements, 11 wholly on real edges, with before/after window captures.
